help.calendar: On the calendar you can move your events and task. Task can in addition be extended if you grab the event at the end. If you double click on a date you can create new ToDo. If you click on an event you get more info and can set the status. With the arrow keys (left, right) you can move between months.
help.calendar-scale_data: The scale calendar does show you the mean weight of your connected hive scales. If you click on the event it shows you the difference to the day before. If events are colour coded, green if the average is higher than the day before and red if it is lower. With the arrow keys (left, right) you can move between months.
help.detail-apiary: Overview of your apiaries. The arrow keys on the top allow you to quickly switch through your apiaries, it is ordered alphabetically. On the first hive tab you can change the order of your hives by clicking on them and using the arrow keys. The number in the brackets after the apiary name is the current hive count. This order will also be reflected in the hive dropdowns. If you click on the info symbol you will get redirected to the selected hive. The car symbol is to move the hive to another apiary. On the tasks tab you can find all the tasks for the hives on this apiary and the weather tab shows you a small widget of the current and future weather predictions for the apiary location.
help.detail-hive: Infos of your hive. The arrow keys at the drop allows you to quickly navigate between hives on the same apiary. The tasks tab is showing all tasks for the current year, but can be changed with the arrow keys or the dropdown. On the info tab you can  see basic statistics.
help.lifecycle: Lifecycle of honey bees, may be useful if you create your own rearing methods.
help.links: If you have any good additions to the list feel free to contact contact us at {'office@btree.at'}
help.map-apiary: You can move your apiary to a new location by drag and drop! Double click on map to create a new apiary. It is not possible to delete apiaries with active colonies on it, you need first to move them. Basic membership limit is 2 apiaries and premium 100 apiaries.
help.map-wind: A simple wind map from meteoblue. It uses your current location if possible.
help.name: Help
help.new-charge: Charges are meant to keep stock of your resources like sugar or treatment consumables. It can also be used for keeping track of charges of your honey jars, best way to write a unique charge for each batch and also write in the note the charge of your honey harvest. For organic beekeepers the charges can be used to keep track of your invoices for your paid organic sugar. The kind checkbox is used if it is an outgoing or incoming charge. Personally I check my storage stocks at the end of every year and use outgoing charges to set the correct level of stock, e.g. only 100kg of 500kg sugar left - create a 400kg outgoing charge of sugar.
help.new-hive: If you add a hive the name must be unique. Date if migration is important if you add task before the first migration. You can create multiple hives by clicking the symbol near the name field. Basic membership limit is 5 hives and premium 1,000 hives.
help.new-movement: Migrations of your hives to have influence on the statistics, as the main tasks use the migration date to check on which apiary the task was done. This allows correct statistics for migration beekeepers.
help.new-queen: It is not mandatory to create queens for your colonies. You can create multiple queens at once if you click the symbol near the name field. Names must be unique. The queen marking field is meant for the colour (click on the symbol on the right) but you cannot also add a number or any other value here. If you do not select a hive for your queen the queen will be visible in the virgin table. As for mother you can select one of your own queens or write in the mother text field, which is meant for external mother queens.
help.new-quicktool: The Quicktool allows you to quickly add the main tasks (feeding, treatment, harvest and checkup). You can easily add tasks for one hive or a whole apiary. The type dropdown lists can be edited in the options, in addition it is possible to add or remove a few fields in the field settings.
help.new-rearing: Here you can create your queen rearing series. Optionally you can set a name and change the symbol (click on symbol before the name input field), to better differentiate if you run multiple series. The date and calculate from step dropdown is connected as it starts to calculate your series from this date and from this step (backwards and/or forwards). The methods you can define to your needs on the queen rearing method page. Queen rearings will be visible on the calendar.
help.new-todo: ToDo's are meant to be used if it is not a direct task for a colony. Otherwise use a checkup. As example of ToDo's are task concerning the apiary, e.g. bring new bottom boards, fix fence. You can create repeating ToDo's if you click the symbol near the date field. ToDo's are normally in the future and not done yet, therefore the standard value for is set as 'Open'.
help.news: Current news, the recent one is on orange colour. Only in english language available.
help.premium: Payments are automatically fulfilled and you should get the premium time added to your account. You may need to refresh or log out and log in again. If you have any problems to not hesitate to contact us at {'office@btree.at'}
help.setting-company:
The company setting pages has two tabs.
 Company tab, allows you to change your current company if you are connected to multiple operations. You can also create a new one, but please be aware that you need to pay premium membership for each one. Admin users can also download here all their data. You can remove your access to the current selected company, but only if you are not the only user on that company. If you want to delete the company, it is only possible if your are the last user and have other companies. Otherwise if you want to delete your account you can use the profile page. Be careful not data recovery is possible for data security reasons.
 On the user tab you can add users which get an invite if they currently don't use the app. The admin can remove users by clicking on the symbol before the email address or change their rank by clickling on the symbol on the right side of the email address. As standard is set read-only which allows users only to see all data but don't change any. Normal users can do most of the tasks but are not allowed to delete anything, cannot manage API access and are not allowed to create or manage hives and apiaries.
help.setting-dropbox: Here you can activate a connection to your Dropbox account. This is per operation, therefore if you have multiple users all have then access to the newly created Dropbox folder. For connection you will be redirected to the Dropbox page. After connection you can always delete the access or your btree account and still keep the uploaded data on your Dropbox.
help.setting-field: On this page you can toggle on or disable fields for various operations. This is per user basis.
help.setting-option: On this page you can create and set most of the available dropdowns. Use the yellow dropdown field to change the option which you want to edit. Favourite means this options is always selected first and after that in alphabetic order, you can only have one favourite at a time. If you deleted an option which is in use this may can break your statistic, therefore it is better to disable (modus) your options which you do not use any more. Feel free to define options as you need, this makes especially sense for checkup types, e.g. added drone frame, cut queen cells, re-queened, varroa control, added honey super, removed honey super ... With this method you can work really quickly in the field and do not need to write common practices in the notes.
help.setting-profile:
On the profile page three tabs exists.
 User tab change the app language (reload may be required), set a username, useful for operations with multiple users and set options for notifications.
 Credentials tab change your current password and email, for both you need first to enter your old password.
 API tab activate with our password, is then activated for every user on the same company. After activation you can click the eye symbol to show your keys. The iCal url you can use to subscribe with your calendar app. It will keep track of the selected source 6 months in the past of the current date and future. If you download the iCal file it will not be auto updated but can for example be used for queen rearing if you do not want to subscribe. The scale API endpoint allows you to send data of your hive scales. With the cloud symbol you can test the API.
help.setting-rearing: On this page you can define your rearing methods to your needs. A method is a collection of multiple rearing steps. If you create a new step the wait time is in hours to the previous step, eg. caging 120 hours (5 days) after crafting. You can sort the steps by clicking on them and then using the up and down arrow symbols on the left. To not forget to save if you make any changes to your methods.
help.statistic-hive_count: Group hives count are not accounted for in the total chart only in apiary chart. Count is calculated from first movement for total chart and last movement for apiary chart. Date of inactivity is date when hive was removed. Deleted hives are not visible.
help.statistic-stats_feed: The yearly feed statistic is not influenced by the year filter. For types and apiaries the current year will be selected as standard and can be changed in the filter options (yellow button).
help.statistic-stats_harvest: The yearly harvest statistic is not influenced by the year filter. For types and apiaries the current year will be selected as standard and can be changed in the filter options (yellow button).
help.statistic-stats_treatment: The yearly treatment statistic is not influenced by the year filter. For types and apiaries the current year will be selected as standard and can be changed in the filter options (yellow button).
help.statistic-table_feed: Yearly total feed for every hive.
help.statistic-table_harvest: Yearly total harvest for every hive.
help.statistic-table_queen: Average rating for queens (zeroes are ignored) and total harvest amount in weight and frames for the duration of the queen on given colony.
help.statistic-table_rating: Yearly average for every hive. In the average calculation zero values are ignored, this is also true for varroa column.
help.statistic-table_treatment: Yearly total treatment for every hive.
help.sugarwater: Calculate your sugar water mixture or look up on the table. How much are effective stored depends on multiple parameters and is not linear, therefore you can only look up the rough estimates in the table.
help.table-apiary: In the apiary table you can manage or export your apiaries. Deleted apiaries can be restored up to 30 days after deletion, but you can only delete apiaries without any active hives on it. In most cases it is better to inactivate the apiary. In addition you can quickly move hives between apiaries, see movements button (blue dropdown button).
help.table-charge: In the charge table you can manage or export your charges. The stock columns is the current stock, which is the sum of incoming minus outgoing goods. Deleted charges can be restored up to 30 days after deletion, it will also change your stock if your delete a charge.
help.table-checkup: In the checkup table you can manage or export your checkups. Deleted task can be restored up to 30 days after deletion. Search field is searching the columns hive and type names.
help.table-feed: In the feed table you can manage or export your feed. Deleted task can be restored up to 30 days after deletion. Search field is searching the columns hive and type names.
help.table-harvest: In the harvest table you can manage or export your harvest. Deleted task can be restored up to 30 days after deletion. Search field is searching the columns hive and type names.
help.table-hive: In the hive table you can manage or export your hives. Deleted hives can be restored up to 30 days after deletion, but be careful all data connected data will we removed if you delete hives, eg. feeding, harvests. In most cases it is better to inactivate the hive. In this table you can also quickly move or add queens to your hives, see the blue dropdown button. Search field is searching the columns hive name and current apiary location.
help.table-movements: In the migration table you can manage or export your colony migrations. You cannot restore deleted data! In addition it is not possible to delete your last migration, as each hive needs at least one connected migration.
help.table-queen: In the queen table you can manage or export your queens. As standard only active queens are shown, which are queens who are on a colony and are the latest ones. You can change this by clicking on the eye symbol. Deleted queens can be restored up to 30 days after deletion.
help.table-rearing: The queen rearing table lets you manage your series. You can click on the timetable column symbol to open a window which shows all rearing steps. Deleted rearings cannot be restored!
help.table-scale_data: In the hive scale data table you can manage or export your entries coming from your hive scale. Deleted data cannot be restored! You can add new hive scales identifier with the scale button. Be careful if you delete a scale identifier all your connected data will be deleted as well without the possibility of restoration. To checkout how to connect your hive scale check the API options page. Basic membership limit is 2 identifier / scales and premium 10 scales.
help.table-todo: In the ToDo table you can manage or export your ToDo's. As standard only open tasks are shown. You can change this by clicking on the eye symbol. You cannot restore ToDo's after deletion!
help.table-treatment: In the treatment table you can manage or export your treatment. Deleted task can be restored up to 30 days after deletion. Search field is searching the columns hive, type and disease names.
help.table-virgin: Same as the queen table but on this table you can only find queens without any hive. This is meant to be used as parking spot for queens in your mating units, which can then be quickly added to your colonies or marked as sold (you can misuse a  dropdown value, e.g. breeding line or use the note field) and set inactive.
